cards.name: Shaman of Fire

effects.printed_clause: With no monsters, Special Summon from hand by sending a Dragon from Extra Deck to GY; if so, Extra Deck Special Summons are FIRE-only for the rest of the turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Custom hand summon procedure selects an Extra Deck Dragon and sends it as procedure cost, then registers an end-turn restriction against non-FIRE Extra Deck summons after success.

official_references.matched_structure: Self Special Summon followed by an Extra Deck-only Attribute/type restriction.

effects.printed_clause: If Normal/Special Summoned: send a Spell listing "Phlogiston Dragon" from Deck, then discard 1; this effect becomes that Spell's activation effect; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Trigger cost selects a CheckActivateEffect-capable listed Spell, sends it plus a discard as costs, then imports its category/property/target and invokes the selected activation operation.

official_references.matched_structure: Official dynamic application of a selected Spell/Trap activation effect using CheckActivateEffect.

effects.issue: Darklord Eveningstar supplies the closest exact engine pattern, but Shaman sources the Spell from Deck and has a two-part cost. There is no official exact analogue for copying every possible custom listed Spell from Deck; event parameters used by arbitrary future Spells remain unmatched.

cards.audit_note: Confirmed as an unresolved custom-reference gap, not a demonstrated Lua defect: Darklord-style activation-effect copying exists officially, but no exact official source covers this Deck-send plus discard custom source set.

coverage_override.reason: All printed procedures, continuous clauses, activated/triggered effects, branches, and attached once-per-turn restrictions are represented in the listed semantic effect records.
